title: A polynomial-space complete language in P
statement: Let $L'$ be a language over the binary alphabet that is polynomial-space complete: $L'$ is decidable in polynomial space, and every language decidable in polynomial space has a polynomial-time many-one reduction to $L'$. If $L'$ is also decidable in polynomial time, then the class of polynomial-space decidable languages equals the class of polynomial-time decidable languages.
